title: Renewal and changes of law for critical honeycomb walks

Every headline exponent rests on bounded-factor bridge-mass, first-moment, long-bridge and diameter estimates (B_h ≍ h^{-1/4}, M_h ≤ C h^{13/12}, B_h{L ≥ c h^{4/3}} ≥ c h^{-1/4}, B_h{D>x} ≤ C x^{-1/4}). The paper is correct only conditionally on those companions, which this audit did not check.

main_claim: For critical honeycomb self-avoiding walk, the infinite irreducible-bridge law has distance n^{3/4+o(1)} almost surely. Uniform strict bridges at every large even length have endpoint distance and diameter n^{3/4+o(1)} in probability. Thermal walks at discount N have L = N^{1+o(1)} and A, D = N^{3/4+o(1)}, with matching moments. Uniform walks have the lower endpoint law on a density-one set of lengths. These follow from companion finite bridge estimates by renewal factorization and changes of law.
